text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our first three years in the Twinkle 
Series with Meisho Doto came to a safe 
conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her results were quite impressive. 
Catching the URA's eye, a certain plan was 
put into motion.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh, a joint award ceremony for Opera 
O-san and meee?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! To honor our achievements, they're 
gathering our fans together.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Doto? Care to perform in 
this special production alongside me?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm honored~. But it feels so amazing 
that I think I'm going to get nervous~.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: What should we do, Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: Wanna try it? I'll come with you.
Want to give it a try? I'll come with you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes. If you'll accompany me, 
Trainer-san, I think I can manage. Please 
look after me~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then—the day of the joint awards 
ceremony.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, *shiver shiver shiver*... Will I be 
okay? Will I be able to run properly?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, it's not even a race. What's the 
point of being more nervous than during an 
actual race?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall enter first, so you may follow 
from behind.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, yes~. L-Let's go, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best, I have to do my 
best!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawawa, I'm so sorry~~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I got hit in the face by the bag's 
strap...

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, Meisho Doto and T.M. Opera O make 
their entrance side by side!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A huge round of applause for the two who 
have brought so much excitement to the 
Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaa... The warmth is soaking right into 
my soul. Everyone is being so kind...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I have to answer them. I have to live up 
to it. Brrrrr...

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Then without further ado, let's have you 
show off your running. A graceful tandem 
run for the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawawawa, the real deal~! H-Here I 
gooooo!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hey! I told you we're running 
side-by-side, didn't I?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving both the fans' expectations and TM 
Opera O in the dust, Meisho Doto surged 
forward...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, where's Opera O-san?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I left it behind, did I-I-I!? Oh no, I did 
it again~~~.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm so sorry~ I'm clumsy and 
slow, and I'm always jumping to 
conclusions~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto seemed to have changed, yet 
remained the same. As clumsy and jittery 
as ever, and—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm going back to do it over again~! So 
that this time, my fans and Opera O-san 
will praise me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's an incredibly sore loser. No matter 
how many times she fails, she never loses 
heart and sees it through to the end.
